description: Which species the row applies to: resident or anadromous, the residence column of the bundle's dimensions.csv. Both must have rows.
The row's place within its residence. Rows are tried in increasing precedence and the first whose when holds sets the token; precedence repeats within a residence are refused.
The mapping code's second token for an accessible segment the row matches: upper-case letters and underscores, and not ACCESS, SPAWN, REAR or INTERMITTENT, which the code's other tokens use.

A condition over the barriers downstream of the segment: any_anth (a human-made barrier), any_pscis (an assessed crossing), any_dam_resident (the next barrier down is a dam), any_dam_anadr (any dam), any_remed (a remediated crossing), joined with &, | and ! and parentheses, or TRUE. Each residence's last row is TRUE, so every accessible segment gets a token.
